title: Latency Tectonics: Route-Model Streaming vs Non-Streaming Stratification Dashboard
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a consolidated dashboard that surfaces latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) across model routes with an explicit split between streaming and non-streaming IO modes. This dashboard (Latency Tectonics) is intended to be the canonical view for on-call engineers and platform owners to rapidly identify regressions, IO-mode-specific tail latency, and model-route interactions that affect user-facing SLOs. The dashboard should integrate trace links for slow tails, expose cohort filtering (model family, route, region, request-shape), and recommend remediation steps (cache tuning, batching changes, model fallback).
scope: Panel: p50/p95/p99 time-series for each model-route with toggle for streaming vs non-streaming
Panel: cohort table showing tail contributors (errors, CPU/GPU spikes, queuing) with percentage contribution
Panel: trace sampler links pre-populated for selected time window and percentile (links to tracing UI)
Panel: request-shape heatmap (sequence length vs latency) separated by IO mode
Alerting: suggested p95/p99 thresholds per-surface and a playbook link
Backfill: compute retrospective baselines for last 90 days for model families used in prod
tasks: Define query predicates and labels required in telemetry (model_name, route, io_mode, region, request_shape)
Add or validate tracing hook that attaches model_name and route to spans (ENG trace instrumentation change)
Implement metrics views/rollups in metrics pipeline (prometheus/metrics-store) for streaming/non-streaming split
Create visualization panels in Grafana/Looker for time-series and cohort heatmaps
Wire trace links for p99 rows to tracing UI with context (sample id, span id, recent logs)
Run a 2-week canary with oncall and platform-sig for feedback and iterate
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for at least 90% of model routes in prod with a working streaming vs non-streaming toggle
Trace links resolve to a trace with model_name and route tags for >95% of sampled slow requests
Cohort filters (model_family, route, region, request_shape) respond within 3s for a 1h window
Oncall runbook entry linked and a suggested p95/p99 threshold per route has been proposed
Data backfill for last 90 days is present and validation checks for missing labels completed
notes: This ticket focuses on observability surface. Any downstream remediation (runtime batching optimizations, model quantization) will be separate tickets referenced from this one.
